ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, B, D, C are on the same straight-line base, and D is between B and C; segment AD connects from A to point D on BC and is inside triangle ABC. Therefore ∠ACB and ∠ACD are the same angle, and ∠BAC is divided by AD into ∠BAD and ∠DAC. Reasoning: Let ∠C = x. Because AD = DC, triangle ADC is an isosceles triangle, hence ∠DAC = ∠ACD = x. It is known that ∠BAC = 78°, so ∠BAD = 78° - x. In triangle ADC, ∠ADC = 180° - 2x. Also because B, D, C are collinear, ∠BDA and ∠ADC form a pair of adjacent supplementary angles, hence ∠BDA = 180° - (180° - 2x) = 2x. Because AB = AD, triangle ABD is an isosceles triangle, and ∠ABD = ∠BDA = 2x. Thus in triangle ABD, ∠BAD = 180° - 2x - 2x = 180° - 4x. The two expressions are equal: 180° - 4x = 78° - x, solving gives 102° = 3x, so x = 34°. Therefore ∠C = 34°.

From the text, use AB=AD=DC and ∠BAC=78°. Let x=∠C. Since AD=DC, triangle ADC is isosceles, so ∠DAC=∠ACD=x. Hence ∠BAD=78−x. Since AB=AD, triangle ABD is isosceles, so ∠ABD=∠BDA. 解方程 sin(102°-x)=sin 2x，得到两种可能：102°-x=2x，或 102°-x=180°-2x。第一种给出 3x=102°，所以 x=34°。第二种给出 x=78°，但若 x=78°，则 ∠DAC=78°，而 ∠BAC 也为 78°，会导致 ∠BAD=0°，与图中 AD 是内部非退化线段相矛盾。因此舍去 x=78°。

所以 ∠C=34°。
